title: GameJam searchable resource node RED-first actual Play contracts
greenCompletionCondition: All GSN product checks pass from structured actual Edit/Play observations; fresh Wave 20 is 16/16, Wave 19 is 21/21, and compile/build/smoke/Addressables/firewall remain PASS. Physical hardware and Steam stay separate.

checks.expected: A live searchable node has far=0, near=1, Interact opens a compact loot tray, the prompt hides, and Cancel restores the same target
checks.actual: InvalidOperationException: no live stable search node was observed
checks.reproduction: Approach a live environmental node, interact, then cancel and inspect the actual prompt/tray objects.
checks.recommendedFiles: runtime search-node target and compact tray owners selected by stable ID/live observation

checks.expected: Same seed+node is deterministic and Cancel, screen transition, and revisit preserve the revealed contents fingerprint
checks.reproduction: Reveal one node, cancel, transition away/back, revisit, and compare structured item/count fingerprints.
checks.recommendedFiles: runtime node content and persistence owners selected by node ID

checks.expected: The same node transitions hidden -> revealed-partial -> depleted and restores the exact remaining item IDs/counts
checks.reproduction: Take only part of a node, save/restore, revisit, then deplete it and inspect public snapshots.
checks.recommendedFiles: runtime node snapshot/save owner selected by node ID

checks.expected: Take, leave, bag replace, and replace-cancel conserve node+bag totals; duplicate Submit has zero cost delta
checks.reproduction: Snapshot bag and node contents around each action and replay the same transaction ID.
checks.recommendedFiles: runtime node/inventory transaction owners selected by structured deltas

checks.expected: Protected parts cannot be discarded, duplicated, or double-consumed; part.raft.sailcloth reaches the raft project exactly once
checks.actual: InvalidOperationException: part.raft.sailcloth not observed in protected parts
checks.reproduction: Reveal/take/retry/discard/consume the same protected part and inspect the raft project inventory by stable ID.
checks.recommendedFiles: runtime protected project inventory and escape.raft owners selected by stable IDs

checks.expected: Exactly seven region IDs expose finite total resources and preserve broken barriers plus permanent-hazard removal across revisit
checks.reproduction: Exhaust a finite node, break one barrier, remove one permanent hazard, leave and revisit each owning region.
checks.recommendedFiles: runtime region catalog/persistence owners selected by stable region IDs

checks.expected: Search time/energy/risk applies exactly once on completion, not Cancel, and new hazard resolution pauses while the loot tray is open
checks.reproduction: Cancel before completion, complete once, hold the loot tray open, and compare time/energy/hazard event ledgers.
checks.recommendedFiles: runtime search transaction and hazard scheduler owners selected by event IDs

checks.expected: Fresh ko/en/qps-long 1280x800 captures exist; the compact tray stays onscreen with overflow/offscreen zero and clears player/walking band
checks.reproduction: Open the actual tray in ko/en/qps-long at 1280x800, capture it, and inspect live Rect/TMP geometry.
checks.recommendedFiles: runtime search tray/localization owners selected by live UI

checks.expected: Keyboard/mouse and synthetic gamepad preserve node/action/item/count/focus semantics while only device prompts change
checks.reproduction: Replay search/take/leave/replace/cancel with both input paths and compare structured results/focus IDs.
checks.recommendedFiles: runtime search input owner selected by action semantics

checks.expected: A live Scene component emits a stable node/region interaction trace with grant=false, warp=false, skip=false
checks.actual: InvalidOperationException: owner=; method=; region=; node=; error=No live Scene component exposed a zero-argument structured search-node observation with node/region/contents/trace/layout state.
checks.reproduction: Discover a live component by structured result shape, invoke its public observation, and independently inspect the returned fields.
checks.recommendedFiles: runtime Play observer selected by result shape, never by product class name

checks.expected: A human completes search/take/leave/replace/cancel on a connected physical gamepad
checks.reproduction: Repeat the full node flow on Windows with a physical controller and retain human evidence.

checks.expected: Approved Steamworks App ID/depot/Input/Cloud/achievements/partner evidence exists
checks.actual: No Steam partner evidence is in scope for this independent gate.
checks.reproduction: Complete the separately approved Steam release workflow.
